title: Thursday Daily Practice
subtitle: Speaking: shadow Hoa, interview a family member, get ready for B8
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Thu 12 Nov (speaking, prepare B8)
intro: Five steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Steps 1 and 5 are voice notes. Step 2 is writing: type it in the box on the website.

steps.title: Step 1 · Shadowing: Hoa's routine
steps.instructions: Read each line, then say it again without looking. Do it 3 times. The third time, say every line a little faster. Record the third time.
lines: 1. My friend Hoa is a very busy student.
2. She wakes up at six o'clock.
3. She makes breakfast for her little brother.
4. Then she goes to school by bike.
5. In the evening, she studies English and watches a short video.
6. She usually goes to bed at half past ten.
7. On Sunday, she does the laundry and cleans her room.
8. She likes her routine because it keeps her healthy.
steps.note: Teacher listens for the -s endings and smooth sentences, not word by word.

steps.title: Step 2 · Interview a family member
steps.instructions:
Ask one person in your family these 5 questions. Write their answers in full sentences with he or she. Type them in the box on the website.
1. What time does he/she wake up?
2. Does he/she cook?
3. How often does he/she exercise?
4. Where does he/she work or study?
5. Why does he/she like his/her routine?

open.model: My mum wakes up at half past five. Yes, she cooks every day. She sometimes goes for a walk, twice a week. She works at a bank. She likes her routine because it is simple.

ai.type: Five answers about another person's routine
ai.task: Write 5 answers in full sentences about a family member, using he or she with the -s ending.
criteria: 5 full sentences that answer the 5 questions
correct -s / -es endings with he or she
a frequency word or phrase in answer 3 (always, twice a week...)

steps.title: Step 3 · Lesson 8 words: student life
steps.instructions: These are Saturday's new words. Choose the best meaning.

options.A: the land and buildings of a university
a test at the end of the year
options.B: money a school gives a good student for studying

options.A: money you pay for your lessons or course
options.B: money you get from a job
a place where students buy and eat food
work that a few students do together
options.C: a group of friends on holiday

options.A: a building where university students live
a group of students who meet to study together

steps.title: Step 4 · Web words from Wednesday
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with one of Wednesday's 20 words on the website.

items.label: 1. My mum has a special ____ for chicken soup. (r)
2. ____ the potatoes before you cook them. (p)
4. I eat the ____ from dinner for lunch. (l)
5. My cousin doesn't eat meat. He is a ____. (v)

steps.title: Step 5 · Speaking Part 1
steps.instructions: Answer the 4 questions. Give 2 or 3 sentences for each answer. Practise first, then record one voice note of about 1 minute.
lines: 1. Do you live near your school or campus?
2. What do you do at weekends?
4. Do you like sport? Why or why not?
steps.note: Teacher listens for full answers (answer + reason or example) and correct do / does.

send_today: Five steps on the website. Voice notes in steps 1 and 5 are sent to the teacher when you press Submit.
